generatedProse.practice-connection: Across the School of Sport, reflection is built into how you train and how you are assessed. Placement logs in sport therapy, coaching commentaries, evaluations of your own study designs in exercise science, and reviews of a participation campaign in sport development all draw on the same practice. Learning to reflect with structure, depth and a clear action now means each piece of sport work becomes something you genuinely learn from, and the habit carries directly into research, coaching and professional practice.
